prompt: A Moon base near the lunar south pole under a very low grazing sun: long black shadows, a pure black sky, Earth low on the horizon. A landing craft descends on a bright exhaust column that kicks up a wide radial spray of grey regolith dust on the left. In the middle, habitat modules half-buried under regolith berms and tall vertical solar-array towers catching the sunlight; on the right, a small power station with large radiator panels and a pressurised rover on a graded road. Photoreal, cinematic, realistic space-agency concept art without any insignia, 35 mm, every element clearly separated, calm dark ground along the bottom.
